extension.description: Use Kimi K3.1 Pro in VS Code Copilot Chat & Agent mode with your Kimi Code subscription or Moonshot AI API key. Automatic model discovery, thinking controls, Kimi Code quota monitoring, and diagnostics. Unofficial provider.
config.title: Kimi
config.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show Kimi Code account usage in the status bar. Refreshes every 60 seconds. Disabling stops usage polling.
config.endpoint.markdownDescription: Select an API endpoint. When Custom is selected, the URL from #kimi.apiBaseUrl# is used.
config.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Custom API base URL. Only used when #kimi.endpoint# is set to Custom. Do not include `/chat/completions`.
config.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescripti: Maximum output tokens allowed per request by this extension. This budget is reserved from the context window; it is not the model's documented maximum output capability.
config.sendDeviceInfo.markdownDescriptio: Send hostname, device/OS details, and a random session device ID to the configured API endpoint. Disabled by default; when disabled, this extension does not collect these details or send device information headers.
config.reasoningEffort.markdownDescripti: Reasoning effort for supported Kimi Code models. Model Default omits the parameter and uses the server default. Ignored when thinking is disabled or the model does not support configurable reasoning effort.
provider.apiKey.description: Kimi Code key from kimi.com/code/console, or an Open Platform key for the Moonshot endpoints
provider.apiKey.title: API key
command.setBaseUrl.kimiCode: Kimi Code: Set API Endpoint to Global (kimi.ai)
command.setBaseUrl.kimiCodeCN: Kimi Code: Set API Endpoint to China (kimi.com)
command.setBaseUrl.moonshot: Moonshot Platform: Set API Endpoint to Moonshot (moonshot.ai)
command.setBaseUrl.moonshotCN: Moonshot Platform: Set API Endpoint to Moonshot China (moonshot.cn)
